thread.title: These Dow and S&P 500 stocks took the biggest hits on fears of a Trump trade war

author: morningstar.com
title: These Dow and S&P 500 stocks took the biggest hits on fears of a Trump trade war
text:
By Philip van Doorn, MarketWatch
The Dow Jones Industrial Average slid 420 points, or 1.7%
Shares of large U.S. companies were hit hard Thursday after President Trump announced new tariffs on steel and aluminum.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average tumbled 420 points, or 1.7%, although it was down as much as 2.3% during the trading session. The S&P 500 Index fell 36 points, or 1.3%.
Read:President tells steel, aluminum executives they'll have 'protection' as he announces tariffs (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/trump-today-president-tells-steel-aluminum-executives-theyll-have-protection-as-he-announces-tariffs-2018-03-01)
More on trade:Steel tariffs to hit these eight countries the hardest (China is not one of them) (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/trump-steel-tariffs-to-hit-these-8-countries-the-hardest-china-is-not-one-of-them-2018-03-01)
